title: IrisCTF 2025
description:
IrisCTF is a 48-hour Capture the Flag competition organized by IrisSec. IrisCTF takes place the first full weekend of every year online, and features challenges in the disciplines of reverse engineering, binary exploitation, web exploitation, cryptography, radio frequency, networks, forensics, open-source intelligence, and more. IrisCTF is meant to be, above all else, a fun, lighthearted, and educational experience for all.

IrisCTF 2025 starts at 2025-01-04 (Jan 4, 2025) @ 00:00 UTC and ends at 2025-01-06 (Jan 6, 2025) @ 00:00 UTC. Registration is open at https://2025.irisc.tf.

Infra sponsored by goo.gle/ctfsponsorship.
prizes:
The top 5 teams will each receive 3x commemorative tokens and event stickers. In addition, the top 3 teams will receive:

1. US$512 cash, HTB 3x 1-Year VIP+ & 3x 3-Month Prolabs.
2. US$256 cash, HTB 3x 1-Year VIP+ & 3x 1-Month Problabs.
3. US$128 cash, HTB 3x 6-Month VIP+.

We will additionally host a writeup competition where 15x US$20 cash prizes will be awarded.

See Terms and Conditions: https://irisc.tf/assets/pdf/irisctf-2025-prize-tncs.pdf

title: UofTCTF 2025
description:
UofTCTF 2025 is the annual capture-the-flag competition organized by the UofTCTF team. This year’s event will take place online from January 10, 2025, at 7:00 PM EST to January 12, 2025, at 7:00 PM EST. It will be a jeopardy-style CTF with classic categories like web, pwn, crypto, rev, forensics, and misc. 

Join the event discord server: https://discord.gg/4mQP8Tk3JE

We extend our heartfelt thanks to our sponsors for making this event possible:
- Dataflow Security
- Zellic
- UofT ISEA
- UofT DCS
